claim: Blocks capture multi-dimensional concepts that single-direction SAEs fragment
published: per-block R²: BSF 0.93–0.97 vs TopK SAE ≈ 0.53 (toy, Fel et al. 2026)
ours: median per-concept R²: BSF 1.00 vs TopK SAE 0.64 (32 sphere concepts in 3-D subspaces of d = 128)
criterion: BSF median ≥ 0.8 and ≥ 0.2 above the SAE

claim: InceptionV1 curve responses form an orientation ring described by a few harmonics
published: one b = 16 block covers all orientations; harmonics 1–3 explain 59/18/12% (89%)
ours: top-16 PCs of mixed3b curve responses: harmonics 1–3 explain 28/26/9% (63%; shuffled-orientation null 95th pct 3%)
criterion: harmonics 1–3 ≥ 50% and above the null's 95th percentile

claim: Control: random mixed3b channels are less harmonic than the curve neurons
published: the orientation ring is specific to the curve family
ours: orientation harmonics 1–3 explain 71% of the 10 curve neurons' responses vs 65% for 10 random non-curve channels
